title: Excellent day out on wheels
text: Excellent morning on a very good mountain e-bike. I had been many times to Granada but not into the Sierra Nevada. Julio was an excellent guide, making sure we were comfortable with our bikes and always checking that no one was left behind. Would recommend.

title: It's a perfectactivit if you're looking tô combine light aventure Nature and culture without toa much physical strain
text:
This e-bike tour along the Via Verde, following the old tram route from Granada to Sierra Nevada, was an absolute highlight of our trip! The path is peaceful, mostly flat, and surrounded by stunning nature and mountain views. Riding an electric bike made it accessible and enjoyable for all fitness levels — we could just relax and take in the scenery.

The route has a special charm, with old railway bridges and tunnels that give it a unique historical feel. Our guide was friendly and knowledgeable, sharing stories about the area’s past and pointing out local plants and wildlife along the way.
author: antoniomasmatao

title: Incredible Adventure – Stunning Scenery and an Outstanding Guide!
text: Exploring the Sierra Nevada on an e-bike was a truly memorable experience. The landscapes were breathtaking, and the route was both fun and manageable. What truly stood out, though, was our guide — knowledgeable, engaging, and genuinely passionate about the region. He added so much value with local insights and made sure everyone felt safe and comfortable. It was like discovering the area with a local friend. Absolutely recommend this tour!

title: Great experience

author: willianf668

title: Amazing experience! Totally worth it!  This e-bike tour along the old tram route to Sierra
text:
This e-bike tour along the old tram route to Sierra Nevada was one of the best things I did in Granada! The trail is beautiful, with stunning views, rock tunnels, and old bridges. The scenery keeps changing, and it gets more amazing at every turn.

The electric bike makes the ride easy and enjoyable, even if you don’t have much biking experience. It’s the perfect mix of nature, adventure, and history.

I really loved it and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a unique and unforgettable activity in the area.
